purpose: Confirm or refute the fast-tier screen-out of H1 (xs-ra-phys-v1) with 10 rotated rounds, and measure plain-swapfile parity on the same disk and zswap setups.
supersedes_nothing: results/xswap-swapin-2026-10-23 and its protocol are preserved unchanged
order: all six case:arm jobs per round, cyclically rotated by round index
decision_rule: A metric change is reported as established only when the 95% bootstrap CI of the per-round geometric-mean ratio excludes 1. Reference-arm between-round CV is reported as the observed noise.
